::: {#def-holm-cutoff}
#### Holm cutoff rank

Given $m$ null hypotheses with p-values and a level $\siglevel$,
order the p-values from smallest to largest,
$p_{(1)} \le p_{(2)} \le \cdots \le p_{(m)}$,
and let $H_{(k)}$ be the null hypothesis with p-value $p_{(k)}$.
The **Holm cutoff rank** $k^*$ is the first rank at which the p-value exceeds its threshold $\siglevel / (m - k + 1)$,
with $k^* \eqdef m + 1$ if there is no such rank:

$$k^* \eqdef \min \set{k : p_{(k)} > \frac{\siglevel}{m - k + 1}}.$$

:::
